_readme: Single source of truth for every word and image on the landing page. Edit this file, then run `npm run build` to regenerate index.html. Anything still in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder the build will warn you about. Every image slot takes a video just as happily: point src at an .mp4 or .webm, add a poster still, and the page plays it on hover (on touch and narrow screens, on focus) with its own mute toggle.
